_about: Editorial wiring for V1.5. It adds NO historical claims: it maps existing curriculum debates and thread paths onto existing node ids so the game can decide when they unlock. Thread members added by the knowledge map but missing from a path are appended automatically. Edit freely; run `npm run data` afterwards.

side_summaries: The institution's failures are structural enough to require replacement—and something must be built in its place.
The institution's failures can be repaired from within.

_threads_note: Per step of each curriculum thread `path`, the node ids that satisfy it (any one). Empty = no playable node (e.g. 'Boynton/context', 'Voting Rights', and the Diaspora / Amefricanidade deepening cards in T-08, which EXPLORE shows as cards).
_boss_note: E040's design_note says it unlocks after at least four linked nodes have been encountered; this overrides the generic 'all linked nodes' unlock rule for that one encounter.
_debate_note: D-08 has no reform node; its side summaries restate the E060 / E15-046-03 reveals (repairable vs. structural). prereq_extra mirrors E060's unlock rule (Abolition and Criminalization introduced).
_thread_unlock_note: Knowledge map rule: a thread unlocks after ≥2 member ideas are introduced AND one encounter linking two members has been played; ≥3 introduced members also unlocks it. 'Introduced' = met through DISCOVER or a single-idea encounter, not glimpsed inside a multi-idea card.

deepening_display.CARD-03: Black educators creating counter-curricula and teaching around oppressive systems.
deepening_display.CARD-05: Cooperate on concrete shared goals without requiring total ideological agreement.

_deepening_note: Player-facing lines for deepening cards that have no core_idea, taken verbatim from each card's `role`. Cards with neither (Amefricanidade, Colonialism) stay in the data layer only.
_thread_responses_note: Historical responses to the demand for respectability, listed in the RESPECTABILITY ↔ REFUSAL thread view. Labels only; drawn from the Black Perspectives audit framing (vengeance feminism, disrepute, self-defense, the respectable center).
